title: Clause decomposition proposal: short wires chained with $ (PROPOSED)
detail: Read-only language-design review answering the owner's 'analiza frazei' idea. Diagnosis: wild rows with subordinate clauses score proposition F1 0.41 vs 0.63; golds flatten clauses into strings, drop because/after/so links, and make 'if' clauses global. Proposal: 'clause TYPE $id' (cause, condition, concession, purpose, before, after, during) and '$id' as a role value (event of a statement or answers of an earlier query); revisits DS021's ban on $ in stated/assumed. Basis: clause analysis + PDTB relations + flat neo-Davidsonian propositions + QDMR-style back-references. No move to a larger model unless there is clear evidence that 270M cannot learn more. If it can still learn, generate more examples with omp + DeepSeek flash. Scope: the proofing LLMs (LanguageProofingLLM on bad_english first, then SymbolicProofingLLM on neuro_english if its targets are ready), with the usual gates: preregistration, dry run, staged early stopping, evaluation on the sealed tests and the composed per-sentence suites.

title: Owner: SymbolicProofingLLM first, LanguageProofingLLM second
detail: Owner 2026-09-30 evening: the bigger risk is whether Gemma 3 270M can cover the forms SymbolicLM does not handle, especially long, tangled sentences. Train and evaluate SymbolicProofingLLM (Gemma 3 270M on neuro_english, decomposition first) before LanguageProofingLLM. LanguageProofingLLM is a more common task, and a larger model is an acceptable fallback there.

title: Owner allows parallel GPU training runs when faster than serial
detail: Owner 2026-09-30: the two Gemma 3 270M trainings (SymbolicProofingLLM, LanguageProofingLLM) may run in parallel on the GPU, provided the parallel run does not take longer than running them one after the other; the orchestrator decides. This relaxes the single-GPU-worker rule for these small runs only.

title: Owner: the fallback base is Gemma 3 1B (LoRA), not Qwen
detail: Owner 2026-09-30: if Gemma 3 270M clearly cannot learn a proofing task, train Gemma 3 1B with LoRA next (preferred over Qwen). Measured laptop-CPU speed of Gemma 3 1B-it: Q4_K_M 25.5-52 tokens/s and Q8_0 27-40 tokens/s at 4 threads (eval/reports/current/cpu-speed/summary.md), about 0.8-1.9 s for a typical message.

title: three datasets rebuild with the accurate engine: analysis done, gate judging started
detail: Analysis cache regenerated with Stanza accurate + rules v2.5 (13,826 messages, GPU batches), spaCy agreement recomputed for the changed trees, sealed-side analysis done, train/dev and sealed test assembled once to produce the gate work lists (1,920 condition-c judgements). Judging with a fresh 25 USD ledger (judge/ledger-accurate.json): condition c on every sentence without a reusable stored verdict, then condition b on the differing sentences c accepts.
